findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "web-search" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: web_search, search_with_contents, news_search · Public sink: search_with_contents.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: web_search, search_with_contents, news_search · Public sink: search_with_contents

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
